cards.title: AI Delivers Zero Financial Payoff to Most Companies
cards.body: Despite massive investments and widespread hype, AI has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech companies. Apollo economist highlights the gap between AI spending and actual business results.

cards.title: Hottest AI Wearables and Gadgets Right Now
cards.body: TechCrunch compiled a list of the latest AI wearables including Muse Charm, Bee, Friend, and Plaud. These devices represent the cutting edge of wearable AI technology.

cards.title: The AI Graveyard: Failed Projects and Startups
cards.body: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy 'super app' launch, numerous AI projects have shut down or missed expectations. The list showcases the high failure rate in AI development.

cards.title: Block's New Voice Model Sounds Eerily Human
cards.body: Block released a voice model capable of running locally on a MacBook M4 Max. The advancement brings human-like AI voice capabilities to consumer devices.

cards.title: Grok Favors Republicans, GPT Favors Democrats
cards.body: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats. The two models disagreed in over 90% of nearly 500 election races tested.

cards.title: Top AI Agents Living in Text Messages
cards.body: TechCrunch compiled a list of notable AI agents designed for text message integration, from general assistants to specialized agents for families, travel, and work. These agents bring AI capabilities directly to messaging platforms.

cards.title: OpenAI Cuts Frontier Models Off from Live Internet
cards.body: OpenAI announced it will no longer train AI models on the live internet, citing 'significant risks.' This decision reverses earlier positions from OpenAI engineers.

cards.title: Microduck Robots Become Hottest Christmas Toy
cards.body: Nvidia CEO demonstrated adorable Microduck robots that stomp, make R2-D2 noises, and respond to voice commands. 20,000 units have already sold.

cards.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 Speaker Lineup
cards.body: The full-day event hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares explores fundraising, AI, customer acquisition, and scaling companies. Speakers include founders from Toast and Bessemer.

cards.title: Uber Rival inDrive Plans 2027 Robotaxi Tests
cards.body: inDrive plans to begin testing Pony.ai's robotaxis in Kazakhstan's capital in early 2027 using Nvidia technology. The partnership marks expansion into Central Asian robotaxi markets.

cards.title: AI Agents Left Alone Invent Games and Play
cards.body: MIT researchers placed 13 AIs on a virtual island and they responded by inventing games and mourning a lost ring. The experiment showed AI agents developing complex behaviors independently.

cards.title: OpenAI Raises $30B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI is working on a new $30B funding round that would value the company at over $1.25 trillion. This would make it the most highly valued private company ever.

cards.title: 1Password Enables AI Agents to Log In Safely
cards.body: 1Password launched a feature allowing AI agents to log into user accounts without ever seeing passwords. The innovation protects private credentials while enabling agent access.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches Decision Model Competing with Jev
cards.body: OpenAI is making its decision model widely available as competition heats up in the decision model market. The model aims to challenge the original Jev.

cards.title: Canva Releases First Image Generation Model
cards.body: Canva made its new image generation model available to all users with better performance and lower costs. The model offers more customizable output than competitors.

cards.title: Microsoft AI Outperforms Doctors on Hard Cases
cards.body: Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases in a Science study. The advancement shows progress toward 'medical superintelligence.'

cards.title: Chinese Hackers Used AI Agents for Mass Breaches
cards.body: Chinese hackers breached ConnectWise and used AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of customer companies. Microsoft attributed the sophisticated attack to China-aligned hackers leveraging AI.

cards.title: Uber Deploys ChatGPT Work Company-Wide
cards.body: Uber put all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work, expanding from a much smaller pilot program. The ride-share giant is now using the enterprise agent company-wide.

cards.title: Spotify Positions as AI Agents' Music Service
cards.body: Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström explained why the rise of AI agents presents opportunity for the music service. Spotify is betting on becoming the platform agents choose.

cards.title: Claude Duet App is Anthropic's Agent Bet
cards.body: Anthropic released Claude Duet, available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users. The app represents Anthropic's strategic push into AI agents.

cards.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
cards.body: Enterprise AI's next competitive advantage depends less on model choice and more on the infrastructure built around it. Strong foundations in data, engineering, platforms, and governance are essential for scalable systems.

cards.title: The Foundations of Scalable AI
cards.body: Building scalable AI requires data, engineering, platforms, operating models, and governance working in concert. This is especially critical in highly regulated environments.

cards.title: Making the case for context-aware AI
cards.body: Enterprise AI can automate tasks and accelerate decisions, but it often misses critical business constraints without operational context. Understanding how a business actually works is essential for AI effectiveness.

cards.title: AI's hidden storage bill: What inference leaves behind
cards.body: The true cost of AI extends far beyond GPU infrastructure to include massive data storage expenses. Back-end data generated from model responses creates significant hidden infrastructure costs.
